{{La Bangu/en}}
==Preface==

''Extended Lojbanic Grammar'' (ELG, formerly [[CLL]] and Berry lessons) is the full reference grammar of [[La Bangu]], a Lojban dialect developed by [[Fancy Generation Lojbanists|Lojbanic community]] in IRC chat channel #lojban. Compared to [[CLL]] ELG is more bulky.

Not for newbies obviously. Not really a continuation of the ''[[La Bangu: The Journey|Crash Course]]''.

ELG is to be written mostly in simple Lojban. Many borrowings from English are expected. Many parts of ELG are based on CLL.

ELG presents different interesting aspects of Lojban language, it's grammar, vocabulary and applications in different fields.
